split.name: Split screen
split.description: Content on top, speaker below (or swapped)

card.name: Card over face
card.description: A content card over the top of the frame; the speaker slides down so the face stays visible

phone.name: Inside a phone
phone.description: The speaker (or a screen recording) inside a phone on a brand backdrop

pip.name: Picture in picture
pip.description: Content fills the frame, the speaker sits in a corner

broll.name: B-roll with face
broll.description: B-roll fills the frame with a slow push-in, the speaker in a round bubble in a corner

bgswap.name: Background swap
bgswap.description: The speaker cut out in front of the brand backdrop or your own image or video

reaction.name: Reaction
reaction.description: A clip plays in a player at the top with its credit; the speaker reacts below

screen.name: Screen with face
screen.description: A screen recording in a large window, the speaker in a bubble on its upper corner

text.name: Text only
text.description: Only the words, landing line by line on the brand backdrop
